The owner's design of mitcad#2143 (opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/loft-circle-slot-reported-test.cmake): on XZ a circle of radius 50 (Sketch1 F1), a plane 100 along Y (Plane1 F5) with a centre-point slot on it (Sketch2 F6, arc centres 73 either side, radius 21), and Loft1 (F8), a surface loft from the circle to the slot. Thickened 1 mm, the thicken failed ('the thickened surface does not close'): the loft's faces met at creases along the lines between them. Now they are tangent there and the surface thickens 1 mm along its normals, against them and symmetric, each a new body, with no warning or information.
